tech.title: Google Escalates Nvidia Rivalry With Specialized Versions of AI Chips
tech.summary: Google is rolling out two new variations of its Tensor Processing Units. The 8tx is aimed at handling secure, confidential work for customers like government agencies and companies in regulated industries. The 8i Max is designed to run AI applications that require long-context windows. Google's TPU business has proven to be lucrative, and the company has netted some high-profile clients including Apple, Meta, and Oracle.

tech.title: Fable 5.2 and Jagged AGI
tech.summary: AI models are likely to soon cross the boundary into Artificial General Intelligence. Claude Fable 5.2 is almost as good as most human experts at most intellectual tasks that can be completed with a computer. It still makes mistakes and requires human guidance, but it demonstrates impressive work in many tests. There are still important areas in many tasks where the model is jagged enough to fall well behind human capability, but it isn't about simple errors or hallucinations anymore.

tech.title: Experimental mRNA therapy promotes repair after heart attack damage
tech.summary: Researchers have developed a treatment that uses mRNA therapy to reawaken heart muscle cells so that they start to divide and help repair damaged muscle. The treatment helped mice produce stronger heartbeats following a heart attack. While not a full cure for heart disease, even small improvements to heart function have been linked to lower mortality. The treatment is short-lived and localized, and is not expected to cause any permanent modification to the heart cells. Further trials in larger animal models are required before human testing can begin.

tech.summary: Storybook is a small, development-only workshop that lives alongside your app. It provides an isolated iframe that renders components without interference from app business logic and context, helping developers focus development on each variation of a component. tech.title: chrome-capture
tech.summary: Chrome 153+ has a native MP4 tab recorder. chrome-capture records Chrome tabs at 60 to 120 frames per second in up to 2160p straight to an AVI .mp4. The recording includes tab audio. Users can start and stop recording whenever they want. Chromo writes AV1 into the mp4 as it goes.

tech.title: Anthropic Prepares to Push Ahead With IPO Despite Market Jitters
tech.summary: Anthropic plans to start trading its shares by the end of next week. Investors anticipated a target valuation of around $1.5 trillion last week, but some major investors are now pushing for it to be lower. Anthropic could still decide to delay its plans and wait for more favorable conditions, but doing so could spark panic in the market. Even before the recent market volatility, investor enthusiasm had been waning for AI names due to increasing concerns about the increasing investments required and a lack of clarity on their potential payoff.
